cases.question: What is the special grace period for unemployment?

response.message: If the Policy Owner is made redundant, there is an option to suspend premium payments for 365 days [1]. During this special grace period, the policy remains fully covered [1]. Unemployment Protection is only applicable to the Basic Plan [2].
